topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I tell ye, the sky’s been gray as a wolf’s belly for days, and this news brings no sunlight either. The tree, that one, it was a sturdy thing, its roots deep like the promise made when it was but a sapling, planted by small hands. To see it gone, well, it’s as if a piece of that young heart's been chipped away. They say change is as natural as the turning of the seasons, but I can’t help but think the world moves too quick, too harsh, with little thought for what’s been lost. May the saints guide those who made this decision, for in the shade of such trees, memories find their peace.
